notes.note: orchestration-service.ts changed only in respondToRequest: an acceptForSession with sessionGrantScope 'all' to an adapter that does not declare it is sent as the plain per-tool answer (scope dropped before the edit-mode check). The captured request-inspection flow (opening and inspecting a request, not answering it with a session scope) does not depend on that path, so the capture stays accurate.
